messages:
Priya (Sales): Heads up — AWS told us they ingested ~12 leads that look like a mix of Marketplace trials and hardware pilot requests. Some same-domain emails, some explicitly claimed by Vertex (HW partner). Need routing rules before EOD.
Emma (Partnerships): Can you paste two examples so we can see overlap? are they exact duplicates or related accounts? :thinking_face:
Priya (Sales): pasted snippet from AWS CSV: ```acme_inc@example.com, acme.hardware+pilot@example.com, acme-trial@acme.com``` several share domain, two have hw tags in notes. One has partner_claim=Vertex, other source=Marketplace.
Mateo (Field): If partner_claim exists and partner is a HW partner, route to partner-engage queue first, they get 48h to respond. If no response, escalate back to field.
Raj (Solutions): Agreed. Also: if source=Marketplace and playground_flag=true => assign to marketplace-ops, but mark SI as interested if they previously engaged.
Emma (Partnerships): Proposal for quick triage rules (one-liner):
  1) partner_claim=hw -> partner-first (48h)
  2) source=marketplace && partner_no_claim -> marketplace-first, notify SI as FYI
  3) same-domain duplicates -> merge into single account, prefer partner-claimed routing
  4) cross-claim (marketplace + hw partner) -> create joint handoff: partner lead + SI tag, schedule 15m sync call
Priya (Sales): love it. What about commission/ownership? we should add a temporary rule: if partner-responds and logs contact -> partner credit, else field retains.
Mateo (Field): add a quick checklist for SDRs to capture on intake: 
  - lead_source, partner_claim, hw_interest_flag, marketplace_offer_id, contact_email_aliases
Raj (Solutions): can we add a short automation? handoff-bot: if partner_claim present -> add tag `si-claim` and ping #partner-ops, wait 48h, then reassign if no activity.
handoff-bot: Auto-action: added tag `si-claim` to acme_inc@example.com, ping sent to #partner-ops. (note: this is a simulated bot message)
Emma (Partnerships): Quick action items: 
  - Priya: share full CSV to /shared/partnerships/marketplace-overlap.csv (due today)
  - Mateo: draft 48h SLA text for partner outreach (due tomorrow)
  - Raj: implement handoff-bot tag logic (small PR)
  - Emma: update intake doc with the 4 triage rules and checklist
Priya (Sales): shared CSV link: https://redwood.internal/s/marketplace-overlap.csv :thumbsup:
Raj (Solutions): I'll open a tiny PR to add `si-claim` tagging and the 48h timer, will @Emma for review.
Mateo (Field): I'll draft the SLA blurb and drop it in the doc.
Emma (Partnerships): OK team — we'll run this as a 2-week pilot. If partners escalate, we revert to manual. Thanks all. :rocket:
